transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called us together to work through the Paint Booth 4 incident. As we all know, the booth was stopped this morning after solvent was found pooled beneath its circulation manifold, and the area is currently cordoned off and isolated from production. Before I can authorize any restart, the incident authorization form requires documented entries across four areas: equipment repair, hazardous-waste handling, production recovery, and disposition of potentially contaminated panels. I need each of you to walk me through what you know so we can close out those four items properly. Let's start with the equipment side — what's the status of the manifold and the repair?

transcript.text: My inspection this morning found a cracked manifold isolation valve seat. Replacing the valve requires exactly 4 hours, and maintenance's lockout worksheet identifies exactly 6 isolation points. I completed the inspection this morning but haven't yet attached the worksheet to the incident record — I'll get that done right after this meeting.
